curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why driving needs full attention, what counts as a distraction, the guide's list, why texting is the riskiest, and the texting law.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per idea; a contrast card for texting risk and the texting law.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover children, friends and pets as distractions and what to do about each.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each passenger and pet rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on handling passengers and pets.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach why in-vehicle controls distract, setting things up before driving, handling devices, using stops and passengers, and not staring at roadside scenes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each habit; a contrast card for before-driving setup versus adjusting at stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when to adjust controls and devices.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who the electronic communication device law covers, that its bans apply while moving, and the four banned uses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on banned device uses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the allowed uses: hands-free calls, voice-to-text, navigation and audio, and the rideshare mounting rule, with the contrasts to banned uses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each allowed use; contrast cards for voice versus video calls and dictated versus typed texts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz sorting allowed and banned uses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the warning period and infractions, and the extra consequences for commercial drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on device law consequences.
